issue.description:
ADR-003's dirtiness contract is that every committed semantic mutation advances the live event sequence, and its measured defect list showed most mutation paths silently write no audit event. Open beads already cover create_issue, dependency, external-reference, and structured-data mutations, but label and resource-key mutations are covered by no open bead. Work needed: inventory all mutating service paths, add audit-event emission to the uncovered kinds (at minimum label add/remove and resource-key add/remove), and add an invariant/regression test asserting no committed mutation leaves the event sequence unadvanced so the defect class is closed structurally rather than patched path-by-path.
